summary: Verified 7.0/10, NOT on par (bar 7.5); no blocker open. GLB art/out/fighters/dunsom/dunsom.glb sha a875cd0f, mtime Nov 6 19:51 from the GF-1 revert commit 89112e613 (byte-identical to the Nov 5 07:38 build the reviewer measured), so the reviewer's clip_range numbers stand; I re-read them (_harness/_reports/closing2_dunsom_clip_range.txt) and the shots. CONFIRMED major: splash/portrait composites (3D render with brush filter on painted plates, figure lit flat pink against warm fires, face ~60 px). CONFIRMED major: attack weight (attack1/attack2 hips 4.0/2.5 cm, foot.L 1 mm, attack2 lantern 0.994 m in one display frame; clips_part0 shows a standing figure swinging the crook). Correction: cast_a1 is not fully foot-locked (foot.L 12.2 cm) and cast_a2 moves the hips 11.4 cm, so the casts are better than 'arm only'; the autos are the core of the major. DOWNGRADED to minor: recall/channel/taunt. Dunsom has no channelled ability (no channel def in content/fighters/dunsom.json; the channel clip plays only for state 'channel', src/sim/movement.ts:468), so the frozen channel never shows in a match; recall now moves (lantern 0.89 m) and only misses the brief's eye-level beat (lantern y min 2.098 m vs head ~1.66 m); taunt is an emote. Minors (icon blade, splash mask grin, value bands mid 43.2) confirmed. Sensitivity: hat 0.62 m flat disc, hood under it is a round dome (closing polish round 2; death-frame top view in closing2_dunsom_sheet.png shows a round head), mask is warm carved wood with amber inlays (closing2_dunsom_face_x3.png, icon_x4.png): not horror/hockey/mannequin. No missed blocker. Subscores: in-game read 8, model/materials 7, animation 6.5, cards 6. Timing not measured (load 23-65).

findings.title: Splashes and portraits are filtered 3D renders pasted onto painted plates
findings.what: All three splashes put the in-game model through a brush filter onto a separate plate; base figure at the right edge in flat pinkish light ignoring the warm fires, no cast shadow/rim/atmosphere shared with the scene, face ~60 px in 1600x900, lumpy faceted hook. Portraits same look. Three distinct stagings exist now.
findings.gauge: LoL splashes are fully painted illustrations with the champion as the lit, dominant focal point and light integrated with the scene.
findings.fix: Use the render as block-in; paint one key frame per skin at 2x in VALE's dusk-lantern key (lantern lights the mask from below), figure 55-65% of frame height, cast shadow and rim matched to the plate, hand-painted mask planes.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced on the current files (Nov 5 PNGs). The light mismatch and filtered render look are clear at 1x.

findings.title: Basic attacks are arm-only snaps with a one-frame lantern jump
findings.what: attack1/attack2 hips 4.0/2.5 cm from f0, foot.L 1 mm; attack2 x_lantern steps 0.994 m in one 60 Hz frame (f20) with no smear. The clip sheet shows a standing figure moving only the crook. Correction to the reviewer: cast_a1 has a 12.2 cm foot.L move and cast_a2 11.4 cm hips, so the casts carry some body; cast_a1 still lacks the brief's rock-back.
findings.gauge: LoL caster autos and casts read through the body at the game camera: wind-up in hips/shoulders, weight shift, prop follow-through.
findings.fix: Re-key attack1/attack2 hip-first (6-8 cm weight transfer, ~15 deg chest counter-rotation), spread the crook arc over 3-4 frames with overshoot, lag the lantern 2 frames on x_lantern.
findings.verifierNote: Autos happen every ~1 s in lane, so this is the most-seen animation; major holds. Scope narrowed: casts are not foot-locked.

findings.title: Recall misses its eye-level lantern beat; taunt barely moves (channel unused in play)
findings.what: Recall now moves (lantern 0.89 m, hand.L 0.72 m) but the lantern never drops below 2.098 m, so the brief's cupped-at-eye-level beat is missing. Channel is near-frozen (head 2.7 cm) but Dunsom has no channelled ability, so the clip never plays in a match. Taunt is a rarely used emote.
findings.gauge: LoL recalls are distinct prop-centred performances.
findings.fix: Dip the crook 35-40 deg at 1.0-1.8 s so the lantern reaches ~1.6 m and both hands frame it; taunt: two lantern knocks with a visible swing.
findings.verifierNote: The previous major (frozen idle/recall) is fixed; what remains is a brief beat on recall plus clips that are unused (channel) or rare (taunt). Not a major.

findings.title: On the face chip the crook shaft reads as a sword blade
findings.what: A pale tapering straight shaft in a fist at the left edge reads as a blade at 48 px; the lantern is only a corner glow.
findings.gauge: LoL icons crop to face plus one unmistakable signature cue.
findings.fix: Re-crop so the hook and lit lantern panes sit upper-left behind the hat rim.

findings.title: Splash filter breaks the lower mask into tooth-like blocks
findings.what: In the base splash the lower mask's facets read as a pale block grin under a dark seam at ~60 px. Not horror; the model and chip read as carved wood.
findings.gauge: LoL masked champions keep clean large mask planes at splash size.
findings.fix: Merge the lower facets into 2-3 painted planes in the card paint-over; drop the seam.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced; not blocker class (no horror read at loading-screen size).

findings.title: Value-gradient gate still fails
findings.gauge: LoL keeps a head-to-feet light-to-dark read.
findings.fix: Lift the coat's upper third to ~L* 52 with a vertical gradient.
findings.verifierNote: Numbers match the file; in-game disc read is fine, polish only.
